subject: Next step: 60-90m technical deep dive with NovaEdge ML/Infra
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sarah O'Brien <sarah.obrien@novaedge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + proposed technical deep dive (60-90m)

Hi Sarah —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned:
- Current infra: NovaEdge runs a mix of batch and online models; production latency variability on p95 is a blocker for your customer-facing features.
- Primary goals: reduce inference tail latency, get predictable throughput for peak windows, and evaluate options for private deployment due to data residency concerns.
- Constraints: tight procurement window (end of Q1), security questionnaire outstanding, and limited cross-team availability on your side.

Next step proposal: technical deep dive (60–90 minutes) with your ML + infra teams so we can:
1) walk through high-level architecture and telemetry you currently have
2) map a deployment target (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
3) surface integration/network requirements and fallback strategies
4) agree on success criteria and next actions for a pilot

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue Dec 8, 10:00–11:30 or
- Thu Dec 10, 09:00–10:30

Attached is a short proposed agenda (Redwood_TDX_Agenda_v1.pdf) and a draft doc with suggested prep/questions: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_TDX_draft

Can you confirm which window works and who from your side will join? If neither works, share a couple of alternatives and we’ll align.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the right folks on the call.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_TDX_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + proposed technical deep dive (60-90m)

Thanks, Aditya — great summary.

A few quick notes from our side:
- We definitely want the ML infra deep dive. Our ML lead Michael Li and security lead Priya Shah should join. Adding Priya on cc.
- Timezones: our team is PST but Dec 8 is tight for Michael. Thu Dec 10 looks better. Can we shift to 10:00–11:30 PST on Dec 10 instead? That gives Michael time to prep.
- Prep ask: could you include a short checklist of network/egress requirements and whether we need an initial VPN tunnel or if private peering is supported? Also send any SOC2 or evidence items we can prep beforehand.

On the agenda PDF — we’ll take a quick look and add any ML-specific telemetry items.

On a related note, please include a call-in/recording option as some of our folks will be remote.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah O'Brien
Director of Product, NovaEdge Inc.
sarah.obrien@novaedge.com

Thanks Sarah — Thu Dec 10 10:00–11:30 PST works for us, happy to lock that in.

Michael / Priya — welcome, and thanks for joining. Quick ask from our side so we can make the session productive:
- Michael: could you share a short diagram (even a screenshot) of your current inference flow (model hosting, ingress, caching/KV usage) and typical p50/p95 numbers for the endpoints you care about?
- Priya: any immediate compliance/network constraints (IP allow lists, required ports, tunnel/proxy) will help us scope the integration approach.

Internal notes: Camila, can you bring a brief on our private deployment checklist and quantization/latency tradeoffs? Neha, please be ready on kernel/runtime questions and fallback routing strategies.

We’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in info and an updated agenda (attach pre-read + agenda).

Thanks all — see you Dec 10 at 10:00 PST.

Best,
Aditya
